comment: Recognition layer 2: community/district name signs. Coordinates are real lat/lon projected into world space the same way as landmarks. triggerRadius = compressed-world meters. needs_owner_review = true flags entries where owner's lived knowledge should confirm or correct. Route: Norman Manley Airport → Palisadoes → Harbour View → Kingston → Spanish Town → Bog Walk → Linstead → Moneague → Faith's Pen → Fern Gully → Ocho Rios.

communities.name: Harbour View
communities.note: Junction where the Palisadoes strip meets Windward Road

communities.name: Rockfort
communities.note: Community along Windward Road east of Kingston

communities.name: Mountain View
communities.note: East Kingston residential community along Mountain View Avenue

communities.name: Cross Roads
communities.note: Major Kingston intersection and community hub

communities.name: Half Way Tree
communities.note: Major Kingston hub — the clock tower marks the centre

communities.name: Six Miles
communities.note: Kingston boundary checkpoint heading west toward Spanish Town

communities.name: Spanish Town
communities.note: Former colonial capital of Jamaica, St. Catherine parish seat

communities.name: Bog Walk
communities.note: Gateway to the famous gorge cut by the Rio Cobre

communities.name: Ewarton
communities.note: St. Catherine town near the Alcan alumina plant

communities.name: Linstead
communities.note: Famous for Linstead Market — 'carry me ackee go a Linstead market'

communities.name: Moneague
communities.note: Small St. Ann town on the A1, home of Moneague College

communities.name: Faith's Pen
communities.note: Legendary roadside cookshop stop — jerk chicken, festival and roast yam

communities.name: Fern Gully
communities.note: Three-kilometre canopy of tree ferns — a natural wonder on the A1

communities.name: Ocho Rios
communities.note: Ochi — St. Ann's Bay tourist capital and journey's end
